text: A significant portion of investments in productive companies and projects comes from venture capital and private equity funds. We assist in structuring these funds, accompany them through their various investments and divestments, and provide tax advisory services to ensure compliance with their diverse tax obligations. As part of our services, we carry out express due diligence reviews designed to quickly identify potential tax contingencies in the target company that could hinder the investment. If required, we also perform in-depth tax due diligences to confirm the amount of contingencies flagged in the express review and to uncover and quantify any additional issues that were not initially detected.
